title: Implement page Orders
context: The shop had no page where a shopper could see past orders. This change adds one, and a link to it in the header of every page. The page shows each order on a row with its date, its status and its total. Four buttons above the rows choose between all orders and the open, the shipped or the cancelled ones. The page shows a message while the orders load, when the request fails and when there is no order to show.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens any page, **then** [the header shows an "Orders" link](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L13) between the "Account" link and the cart badge.
- **When** a shopper opens `/orders`, **then** [the page shows "Loading your orders…"](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9) until the request to `/api/orders` answers.
- **When** the request answers with orders, **then** [the page shows one row per order, with its date, its status and its total](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L6-10).
- **When** the request answers with an empty list, **then** [the page shows "No orders to show."](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L15-16) under the four buttons.
- **When** the request fails, **then** [the page shows "Your orders could not be loaded."](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L10) and no buttons.
- **When** a shopper clicks "shipped", **then** [the app requests `/api/orders?status=shipped`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5).
- **When** the page shows the shipped orders, **then** [the "shipped" button is disabled](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L16).

- **When** a shopper clicks a status whose orders were not requested before, **then** ["Loading your orders…" replaces the buttons and the rows](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9) until the request answers.
- **When** a shopper leaves `/orders` and comes back without a reload, **then** [the page still shows the status chosen before](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L9-14).
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue, the cart or the account page, **then** nothing changes below the header.
## Implementation
**`src/router.tsx`**
- Added [the import of `OrdersPage`](code:src/router.tsx#L5).
- Modified [`router`](code:src/router.tsx#router) to [render `<OrdersPage />` at the path `orders`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), under the `/` route.
**`src/routes/orders/index.tsx`**

- Added [`<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage), a component that [reads the chosen status from the filter store](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), [calls `useOrders()` with that status](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L8) and renders [a loading message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9), [an error message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L10), [an empty message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L15-16) or [one `<OrderRow />` per order](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L18-22).
**`src/stores/order-filter-store.ts`**
- Added [`OrderFilterState`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#OrderFilterState), an interface with `status` and `setStatus`.

- Added [`useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore), a Zustand store that [starts with `status: null`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L10) and whose [`setStatus()` calls `set({ status })`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L11-13).
- Added [`selectStatus()`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#selectStatus), a function that [returns `state.status`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L17).
**`src/types/order.ts`**
- Added [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus), a type that is `"open"`, `"shipped"` or `"cancelled"`.
- Added [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order), an interface with `id`, `placedAt`, `status` and `totalCents`.
**`src/api/orders.ts`**
- Added [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders), a function that [requests `/orders` for `null` and `/orders?status=open` for `"open"`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5).
**`src/hooks/use-orders.ts`**

- Added [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders), a hook that [calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", status]` and a query function that calls `fetchOrders(status)`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L6).
**`src/routes/orders/components/`**

- Added [`<OrderRow />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#OrderRow), a component that renders one `<li>` with [the date of `order.placedAt`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L7), [`order.status`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L8) and [`formatPrice(order.totalCents)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L9).
- Added [`STATUSES`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#STATUSES), a constant with `"open"`, `"shipped"` and `"cancelled"`.

- Added [`<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter), a component that renders [an "All" button that calls `setStatus(null)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L12-14) and [one button per entry of `STATUSES` that calls `setStatus()` with that entry](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L15-19).
**`src/routes/root-layout.tsx`**
- Modified [`<RootLayout />`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#RootLayout) to [render `<Link to="/orders">Orders</Link>`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L13) after the "Account" link.
diff: +  return useQuery({ queryKey: ["orders", status], queryFn: () => fetchOrders(status) })
+        <Button key={option} variant="ghost" disabled={status === option} onClick={() => setStatus(option)}>
+  const { data: orders, isPending, isError } = useOrders(status)

+ if (isError) return

Your orders could not be loaded.

journeyNodes.label: Queries the orders under one key per status

Two Entry Points reach this hook:

- When a shopper opens `/orders`, [`router` renders `<OrdersPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), and [`<OrdersPage />` calls this hook with the `status` it read from the filter store](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7-8). That `status` is `null` until a shopper clicks a status button.

journeyNodes.label: Requests the orders of one status, or all orders
journeyNodes.description:
Two Entry Points reach this function:

- When the app starts, `src/main.tsx` passes [`router`](code:src/router.tsx#router) to `<RouterProvider />`, and nothing calls this function until a shopper opens `/orders`.
- When a shopper opens `/orders`, [`router` renders `<OrdersPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), [`<OrdersPage />` calls `useOrders(status)`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L8), and [`useOrders()` hands `useQuery` a query function that calls this function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L6). `useQuery` runs that query function when the key `["orders", status]` has no data that is still fresh.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrders()` to query the orders per status
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `useOrders()` that calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", status]` and a query function that calls [`fetchOrders(status)`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders). The status is part of the key, so that [a new `status` in `<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7-8) reads another cache entry, and starts a request when that entry has no data. `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `staleTime` to 30 000 ms and `retry` to `false`, so one failed request sets `isError` to `true`.
waypoints.needsAttention: This function is where a chosen status becomes a request: the status is part of the query key, so `useQuery` requests and caches each status on its own. [`<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage) shows what this function returns for the chosen status.

journeyNodes.label: Holds the chosen status and replaces it on a click
journeyNodes.description:
Four Entry Points reach this store:

- When the app starts, `src/main.tsx` passes [`router`](code:src/router.tsx#router) to `<RouterProvider />`, and nothing reads this store until a shopper opens `/orders`.
- When a shopper opens `/orders`, [`router` renders `<OrdersPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), [`<OrdersPage />` renders `<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L14), and [`<OrderStatusFilter />` reads `status` and `setStatus` from this store](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L8-9). [`<OrdersPage />` reads `status` from this store too](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), and the diagram draws no edge for that read.
- When a shopper clicks "All", [the `onClick` of that button calls `setStatus(null)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L12).
- When a shopper clicks "open", "shipped" or "cancelled", [the `onClick` of that button calls `setStatus()` with its own status](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L16), such as `setStatus("shipped")`.

The trace assumed the two edges from the handlers: [`<OrderStatusFilter />` reads `setStatus` through an inline selector](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L9), and no import names it.

summary: Added [`<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter), a component that renders [an "All" button that calls `setStatus(null)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L12-14) and [one button per entry of `STATUSES` that calls `setStatus()` with that entry](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L15-19).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of `Button`, the filter store and `OrderStatus`
waypoints.reading: The author added three imports that name [`Button`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L15-17) from `@/components/ui`, [`selectStatus()`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#selectStatus) and [`useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore) from `@/stores/order-filter-store`, and the type [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus) from `@/types/order`. [`<OrderStatusFilter />` renders the buttons and reads the store](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter), and [`STATUSES` is an `OrderStatus[]`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L5).

waypoints.title: Added `STATUSES`, the statuses the filter offers
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `STATUSES` that lists `"open"`, `"shipped"` and `"cancelled"`. [`<OrderStatusFilter />` renders one button per entry](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L15-19), so that the order of the array is the order of the buttons after "All". The type `OrderStatus[]` gives a compile error for a string outside [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus), and none for a member the array leaves out.

waypoints.title: Added `<OrderStatusFilter />` to choose a status
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<OrderStatusFilter />` that:

- reads `status` with [`useOrderFilterStore(selectStatus)`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#selectStatus), and `setStatus` from the same store
- renders an "All" button that calls `setStatus(null)`
- renders one button per entry of [`STATUSES`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#STATUSES), and each calls `setStatus()` with its own status, such as `setStatus("shipped")`
- sets `disabled` on the button whose status equals `status`

[`setStatus()` writes the status to the store](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L11-13) and [`<OrdersPage />` reads it from there](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), so that a click changes the list with no prop between the two components. [`<Button>` passes `onClick` and `disabled` to a `<button>`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L15-17).

segments.title: The header link to the orders page

journeyNodes.label: Shows the header link to the orders page
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens any page, [`router` renders this layout for the path `/`](code:src/router.tsx#L10-11), and this layout renders the page of the matched child route in its `<Outlet />`.

files.title: The header links to the orders page

waypoints.title: Added the "Orders" link to the header
waypoints.reading: The author added a link to the component `<RootLayout />` that renders `<Link to="/orders">Orders</Link>` in the header, between the "Account" link and `<CartBadge />`. [`router` renders `<RootLayout />` for the `/` route and around every child route](code:src/router.tsx#L10-11), so that a shopper reaches [the `orders` route](code:src/router.tsx#L16) from every page.
